sources.note: Vision Infonet corporate site. Company overview: founded 1999, 600+ staff, 2000+ clients, $200M+ claims handled. Lists services: billing, coding, transcription, denial management, MDCare EMR/PMS, back office. Testimonials from physicians in pulmonary, psychiatry, critical care.

MDCare EMR/PMS product homepage. Web-based ONC-certified EMR+PMS v6.0. Lists core features: EMR, PMS, billing/AR, lab integration, eRx, patient portal, fax integration, HIPAA email. AI capabilities including speech-to-text, SOAP note generation, AI coding. Serves 1-100+ physician practices across multiple specialties.
Mandatory disclosures PDF. Could not be parsed/read - appeared to be a compressed PDF that did not render as accessible text. Created by Dr. Murali using Word 2016, modified May 2025.

LinkedIn company page. Lists 501-1000 employees, partnership, founded 1999, Naperville IL. Specialties: Healthcare, EMR, Medical Billing and Coding, Transcription, Healthcare IT, PACS, RIS. Serves solo practices to 400+ physician groups. Key personnel: Dr. Vijay Prodduturi, Vikram Prodduturi.

Features page (404 at time of research, but search engine snippets revealed module list: E-Prescribing, Scheduling, Clinical Documentation, POS, EM Coding, Decision Making, Patient Education Forms, HL7 Interface, Integrated Billing Module, Document Editing & Management, Denial Management Module. Also: automated CPT coding, clinical decision tools, DICOM/HL7/Lab/Fax interfacing, 1000+ patient education handouts.)
Specialties page (404 at time of research). Search snippets indicated MDCare supports multiple specialties with customizable templates.
